Just wanted to give everyone a quick update on a few things:

Sets

The underlying set code looks pretty good so far. We are very pleased that the added complexity we introduced has not negatively impacted Voat. So, we are adding a few new test Voat sets (very basic vanilla sets to start with) to the lineup and will see how things look.

We have a few more things to take care of before enabling user created sets but this will be out in the next few days hopefully.

Check out the simple sets we made and let us know your thoughts:

https://voat.co/discover/set

Comment Sort

We’ve introduced a new setting in your profile for sorting comments. You can now choose what default sort order you want for comments. When you enter any comment page, your default comment sort will be used. Everyone’s comment sort is set to Top, which was the current behavior. You can still select different sorts on any page.

Anonymized Mention Blocks

We’ve also introduced a new setting in your preferences to block mentions originating from anonymized submissions. While anonymized submissions are a unique feature of Voat, they have been used as a mechanism for abusing Voat’s notification system, so we had to offer users the option. If you have this setting turned on, user mentions originating from anonymized submissions will be dropped. Please note that you will receive all other notifications from anonymized submissions such as comment and submission reply notifications.

That's all Voat, just a quick update.
